summary: U3 stock-firmware refresh interval exceeds the manufacturer retention requirement
description: Stock libDaisy 08087203 configures SDCLK 100 MHz and COUNT 2054, yielding 168.3456 ms for 8192 rows. ISSI RevB pp1,16 requires 8192 refreshes per 64 ms. ST RM0433 Rev9 pp877–878 explicitly clocks COUNT with SDCLK and defines COUNT+1. Both source URLs are documented in core-review.md. Routing cannot correct the discrepancy.
recommendation: Resolve a manufacturer-supported RAM and approved stock firmware combination. Do not modify application or bootloader privately under the 1:1 firmware requirement.

summary: Y1 ordered crystal is a four-pad 3.2×2.5 mm package on a two-pad 3.2×1.5 mm footprint

recommendation: Replace symbol and footprint with the exact four-pad land pattern, ground case pads and preserve 16 MHz; alternatively select a genuinely matching two-pad MPN.

summary: U1 VCAP capacitors are remote and their BOM orders 22 µF instead of required 2.2 µF
description: F13-to-C13/C14 distances are 12.280/29.422 mm; M10 distances are 15.158/32.039 mm. Both schematic values say 2.2 µF, but native XML BOM orders CL10A226MQ8NRNC/C59461, which is 22 µF ±20%, 6.3 V X5R. Samsung catalog PDF p20 lists the 22 µF base code; exact LCSC product confirms complete MPN. ST DS12556 pp96,201 requires 2.2 µF ±20%, ESR <100 mΩ. Nominal 22 µF is not a compliant substitution.
recommendation: Select a verified 2.2 µF low-ESR part with compliant effective capacitance, correct both MPN and LCSC mapping, and place one directly at each VCAP ball with a short ground return.
